summary: Episode discusses Interactive Brokers platform advantages, multiple stock positions. Host increased Salarie after post-report drop, bought oversold Acure then took 55% gains, maintains Tiger Brokers position despite China regulation news, and is researching bombed-out Portillos. RCI Hospitality discussed as avoid due to serious legal issues involving tax evasion and bribery.
key_takeaways: Salarie presents 40-60% upside potential after recent pullback
Acure was oversold at 9, provided 55% gains from data center hype that was overdone
Tiger Brokers trading at P/E 11-12 with margin expansion potential to 60-65%
Portillos bombed from 40 to 6, insiders buying, but expansion execution risk remains
RCI Hospitality avoid due to entire management team facing prison time for tax evasion scheme
